items.title: Detect duplicate redemption of single-use value
items.objective: Determine whether concurrent requests redeem one coupon, gift card, credit, voucher, or token more times than allowed.
prerequisites: A sequentially verified business invariant and authoritative state/ledger view
Disposable synthetic resources, explicit concurrency ceiling, monitoring, and cleanup/rollback plan
steps: Run a sequential control and record authoritative before/after state
Create a fresh equivalent disposable resource
Prepare only the minimum identical or coordinated requests and release them simultaneously
Collect every response, verify authoritative committed state, stop, and clean/void the resource

examples.note: Use a tiny synchronized request set against one disposable object; never use a flood or production transaction.

items.manipulate: Request timing and concurrency only while keeping the designated identity, synthetic resource, and business inputs controlled
items.secure_behavior: The invariant is enforced atomically: one operation commits, conflicting requests fail/retry safely, and ledger/object state remains consistent.
items.vulnerable_behavior: more committed redemptions/value occur than the synthetic resource permits
items.validation: Count authoritative committed effects rather than success responses, repeat only once with a fresh synthetic resource, and exclude eventual-read lag, retries, and duplicate response delivery.
false_positives: multiple success responses can collapse to one ledger entry
a resource can intentionally allow several uses
items.impact: A confirmed race can duplicate value or transactions, oversell inventory, bypass single-use tokens/limits/authorization, expose unvalidated files, or create impossible workflow/account state.
evidence: Sequential control and exact synchronized request count/method
All raw responses with timing/stream identifiers
Authoritative before/after object or ledger state
Concurrency ceiling, monitoring, cleanup, and proof no unrelated resource was affected
tools: Turbo Intruder with a strict request cap
